backrooms.description: Dreamcore Liminal Case is a psychological liminal horror game set deep within the Backrooms. You play as Detective, sent to investigate a mysterious murder. Your investigation leads you through surreal liminal worlds where familiar places become distorted, empty, and unsettling.
